/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: The test result row is overwritten with the latest outcome; replay leaves one current result.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Integration connection test

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Guarded state check; preview/size are overwritten with checksum-anchored identical values.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Knowledge: scan and parse

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Deterministic chunk ids (version id + chunk text) skipped when present; index record is an upsert.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Knowledge: index approved version

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Delete-by-version is idempotent; retrieval never depends on it succeeding.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Knowledge: remove retired version from the index

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: AccountDeletionService is idempotent; leftover checkpoint runs are tracked in the ownership index until purged; completion is guarded.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Privacy: delete account (requested)

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Upserts by run id after verifying the checkpoint's recorded owner; bounded batches; never scans the store.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Privacy: index historical preparation runs

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Delete-thread is idempotent; the index row is removed only after a successful purge.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Privacy: purge a preparation run

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: Events are unique per provider event id; every upsert is keyed on provider ids; a processed event is a no-op.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Billing: process a normalised event (mock)

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: The provider gets a stable idempotency key (same key, same provider refund id); the local update is state-guarded, so a replay after a crash counts once.
/admin/jobs/types.label: Billing: execute an approved MOCK refund

/admin/jobs/types.idempotency: A terminal evaluation is a no-op; the result is bound to one config hash and replay re-derives the same verdict.
/admin/jobs/types.label: AI configuration: deterministic evaluation

known_gaps: German occupation-specific compensation is aggregate (Eurostat SES); Destatis not yet acquired (§18/§47).

Router sends some role phrasings ('data scientist role overview', 'what does an electrician do') to the vector lane, so they return general (not occupation-grounded) evidence — a routing-coverage gap, not a safety gap.
Credential coverage is fixtures-only (5 records); regulated-profession coverage not yet normalized (§22/§47).
Emerging AI roles (AI Engineer, LLM Engineer) are not in the official taxonomies yet — return general/insufficient by design (§47/§52).
Compensation→canonical-occupation linkage is 825/1913 (official codes only; no fuzzy title matching by design, §16).
